concept.title: Canaux de schéma Firefox et validation
concept.shortdesc: Ce sujet décrit entièrement le workflow de canal de schéma pour la localisation française : Canaux de schéma Firefox et validation. The Firefox schema channel controls which policies and values BPM can validate and show as supported.

conbody.p: Ce sujet décrit entièrement le workflow de canal de schéma pour la localisation française : Canaux de schéma Firefox et validation. Choose Firefox ESR 140.12 for the supported Extended Support Release channel, or Firefox Release 152 for the current mainstream channel. Schema choice changes available controls, validation messages, and whether a setting is supported, unavailable, deprecated, unknown, imported, or preserved as raw data.

section.title: Channel choice
section.p: Ce sujet décrit entièrement le workflow de canal de schéma pour la localisation française : Canaux de schéma Firefox et validation. The supported schema channels are ESR 140.12 and Release 152. Choose the channel that matches the browser fleet before import, validation, detailed editing, or export.

section.title: Validation
section.p: Ce sujet décrit entièrement le workflow de canal de schéma pour la localisation française : Canaux de schéma Firefox et validation. Validation checks the profile against the selected schema and BPM normalized model. Run validation before export, after JSON edits, after import, and before comparing important profiles.

section.title: Release and ESR differences
section.p: Ce sujet décrit entièrement le workflow de canal de schéma pour la localisation française : Canaux de schéma Firefox et validation. Common policies such as DisableTelemetry validate in both supported channels. Release 152 can also support newer controls such as AIControls and VisualSearchEnabled that are absent in ESR 140.12.

section.title: Supported, unavailable, deprecated, unknown, and raw states
section.p: Ce sujet décrit entièrement le workflow de canal de schéma pour la localisation française : Canaux de schéma Firefox et validation. Supported settings can be edited and validated for the selected schema. Unavailable or unknown settings should be reviewed before handoff; deprecated settings may still exist but require current-channel confirmation; raw fallback values should be preserved or removed deliberately.

section.title: Migration expectations
section.p: Ce sujet décrit entièrement le workflow de canal de schéma pour la localisation française : Canaux de schéma Firefox et validation. Switching schema channels is a review decision, not a silent migration. Revalidate after switching and inspect Release-only, ESR-absent, imported, raw, or deprecated values before saving or exporting.

section.title: Example boundary
section.p: Ce sujet décrit entièrement le workflow de canal de schéma pour la localisation française : Canaux de schéma Firefox et validation. A common valid example uses DisableTelemetry. A Release-only valid example can use AIControls or VisualSearchEnabled. The same AIControls document is unsupported on ESR 140.12, and wrong value types such as a string value for DisableTelemetry are schema-invalid.

section.title: Recovery
section.p: Ce sujet décrit entièrement le workflow de canal de schéma pour la localisation française : Canaux de schéma Firefox et validation. If validation fails, read the affected policy path, confirm the schema channel, inspect the setting in All Settings or JSON Editor, and only then edit, remove, or preserve the value.
